Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is very simple.
Basic steps:
Put a small amount of moisture on the tragus (the small protrusion on your ear).
Clip the earpiece on your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy until you feel a light tingling sensation. 
You can then go about normal activities while using it — reading, working, meditating, etc.
Typical routine:
Use it for 30–60 minutes per day
Many people use it in the morning, or split it between morning and evening.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase while keeping the sensation pleasant and comfortable. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s recommended to speak with our clinical team before starting.
